diagram_previews.alt: Two horizontal parallel lines: the upper through A and E, the lower through C and F, with E and F to the right; point D lies between the lines to the right of A and C, and segments AD and DC are drawn.

Case (a): parallel lines through A and E (top) and through C and F (bottom), with D between them on the side of E and F, the bent path A-D-C, the dashed parallel DG to the left meeting AC at G, and the alternate angles at A and D (red) and at C and D (green) marked.

Case (b): the same parallel lines with D between them on the other side of line AC, the dashed parallel DG pointing towards AC, the obtuse angles EAD (red) and FCD (green) and the angle ADC (blue) marked.

difficulty_rationale: A routine procedure with a little reasoning.
